Active grille shutters for passenger vehicles: CBP rulings (e.g., NY N325xxx) classified active grille shutters in 8708.29.5160 (other parts and accessories of bodies, other) or 8708.99? I recall a ruling classifying an active grille shutter under 8708.29.5160 as a body part. Others considered 8708.99.8180 (other parts) for radiator-related items. Since the shutter is mounted behind the grille, in front of the radiator, and regulates airflow for aerodynamics and cooling, the ruling I recall (HQ H3xxxxx, 2023?) concluded it's a body part: 8708.29.5160 (other parts and accessories of bodies, other: other). The current HTS statistical suffix for 8708.29.5160 is "Other" under "Other" within 8708.29.51 (for vehicles of heading 8703). I'll go with 8708.29.5160.

{"hts_code": "8708.29.5160", "reason": "The active grille shutter is a motorized louver assembly mounted behind the grille that serves as a body part or accessory of passenger motor vehicles, so it falls under heading 8708 as other parts and accessories of bodies."}
